record_scope_reconstruction: Initial Singapore visitor prohibition is national; mapped coverage here is its Malaysian land-entry component at Woodlands road/rail and Tuas road. Later VTL bus eligibility applies specifically to Causeway/Woodlands, not automatically Tuas or rail.

source_checks.finding: MOH initial entry/transit prohibition distinguishes short-term visitors from returning residents and pass holders.
PMO launch explicitly specifies designated buses across Causeway and describes Tuas as a future extension.
Official indexed release names both Woodlands and Tuas and over 11,000 April 1 travellers; does not separate direction or immigration category. Direct redirected page inaccessible.
